visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages AND Cascade Sotheby's Bend agent directory: real broker names, Oregon licenses, transparent-PNG headshots, and — the thing a directory does not have — each broker's OWN MLS record as a figure with the places behind a disclosure, plus a map of every closing the three of them hold.

beats.text: P6: every roster card shows the Oregon license number as a credential, not a buried footnote.
P0: the desktop hero carries the license line plus Call, Text, Email, and Schedule CTAs in the first viewport.
P3: a listings or closings rail (atlas or recorded sales) is a real second section, not a one-screen directory.
P2: Schedule stays on the reach row with Call/Text/Email — regression, never an orphaned fourth action.
Index is roster only: doors to /team/[slug]. Not a second About — no Proof, FAQ, or seller ask on /team.
Each card is a person (photo, name, title, license) not four equal hairline contact cells.
Broker profile fold: license + Call/Text/Email/Schedule. Firm proof is the default; personal record only when real.
Call is the primary conversion on cards and the profile. Text, Email, and Schedule remain. Do not invent a personal volume hero.

note: SITE-74 2026-09-10. /team first viewport is editorial AboutFaces (principal at conversation scale, companions as rows, Call as the one primary reach, Oregon license as a credential) beside V3Atlas of every Ryan Realty closing with a coordinate. shadcn Avatar adapted as image plus initials fallback. Still not a second About: no Proof, no FAQ, no seller ask. Per-broker figure still from getBrokerSales via broker-roster-record.ts.

beats.text: P6: the profile face shows the Oregon license number as a credential, not a buried footnote.
